source_name: НБУ — Реєстрація платіжних систем, учасників платіжних систем та технологічних операторів платіжних послуг (Реєстр платіжної інфраструктури / РПІ)
why_relevant: This is the NBU landing page for the Register of Payment Infrastructure (Реєстр платіжної інфраструктури), the statutory register created under the Law of Ukraine 'Про платіжні послуги' (No. 1591-IX). Since 01.08.2024 payment systems, payment system participants and technological operators of payment services (технологічні оператори платіжних послуг, ТОПП) may operate in Ukraine only once entered in this register. The ТОПП category is the single most valuable list for this run: it is where payment-technology vendors (processors, gateways, terminal/software providers, tokenisation and switch operators) are legally enumerated — i.e. Printec's direct competitors and partners. The page also carries the registration Regulation and NBU decisions on inclusion/exclusion.

source_name: НБУ — Авторизація надавачів фінансових платіжних послуг та надавачів обмежених платіжних послуг
why_relevant: NBU authorisation hub for the nine statutory categories of payment service provider (надавачі фінансових платіжних послуг: банки, платіжні установи, малі платіжні установи, установи електронних грошей, філії іноземних платіжних установ, оператор поштового зв'язку, НБУ, Казначейство, кредитні спілки). Together with the RPI this defines the complete licensed actor population on the payments side — the census from which competitor and partner target lists are enumerated. Available in both uk and en, which makes it usable for cross-checking transliterations of institution names.

source_name: НБУ — Ліцензії на провадження діяльності з надання фінансових послуг (небанківське ліцензування)
why_relevant: Licensing register for non-bank financial service providers supervised by the NBU since the 2020 'split' (transfer of Nацкомфінпослуг functions). Captures фінансові компанії that sit adjacent to the payments value chain — money remittance, e-money, lending fintechs — many of which are buyers or resellers of payment infrastructure and therefore candidate partners/competitors.

source_name: Національна платіжна система «Український платіжний простір» (ПРОСТІР) — офіційний сайт
why_relevant: The NBU-operated national card scheme. Its site publishes the participant roster (banks + non-bank institutions), the acquiring/issuing split, indirect participants (непрямі учасники), and headline infrastructure counts. Fetched successfully in this run: the About page reports 48 участників, ~516k cards, ~15k ATMs, ~603k payment terminals, ~23k self-service terminals. The participant list is a directly usable target census for acquiring/terminal-estate work, and the ATM/POS/kiosk counts bound the addressable hardware and service market. Sections 'Для учасників' and 'Для бізнесу' also expose certification and joining documentation, which names the technical requirements vendors must meet.

source_name: Data.gov.ua — Інформація щодо учасників Національної платіжної системи «Український платіжний простір» (ПРОСТІР)
why_relevant: Machine-readable open-data mirror of the PROSTIR participant roster, published by the NBU as data holder. Structured files avoid scraping the HTML site and give a stable, versioned name-list of banks and non-bank participants with EDRPOU identifiers — the cleanest enumeration substrate for downstream cells.

source_name: Data.gov.ua — Національний банк України (розпорядник даних, повний каталог наборів)
why_relevant: The NBU's publisher page on the national open-data portal is a pointer-to-pointers: it enumerates every dataset the central bank is legally obliged to publish, including payment cards in circulation, cashless payments by terminal, payment infrastructure counts, PROSTIR participants, e-money issuers and financial-institution register extracts. One crawl of this catalogue yields the full inventory of NBU machine-readable registers without guessing URLs.

source_name: Data.gov.ua — Реєстр наборів даних, що перебувають у володінні Національного банку України
why_relevant: A register OF registers: the NBU's own machine-readable index of its datasets (identifier, name, formats, hyperlink, metadata). This is the cheapest single artefact to seed an automated NBU source inventory and to detect when the central bank adds a new register — e.g. a new payment-infrastructure or ТОПП dataset.

source_name: Data.gov.ua — Перелік банків України, які мають право здійснювати випуск електронних грошей
why_relevant: Authoritative name-list of banks authorised to issue electronic money. E-money authorisation is a strong predictor of which institutions are building wallet/tokenised-payment products and therefore procuring payment software and infrastructure — a high-signal shortlist within the broader bank population.

source_name: НБУ — Довідник банків та їх відокремлених підрозділів (з API-інструкцією)
why_relevant: The NBU bank directory (Довідник банків) with documented API access covering banks AND their separate subdivisions/branches. Branch-level granularity is what turns a bank name-list into a physical-footprint map (how many outlets each bank runs, and where) — directly load-bearing for sizing self-service and branch-automation demand, which is Printec's core adjacency. The published PDF documents the API endpoints and field structure.

source_name: НБУ — Платежі та розрахунки / Платіжні системи (розділ сайту)
why_relevant: Hub section aggregating the payment-systems landscape: SEP (Система електронних платежів), PROSTIR, registered international and domestic payment systems, oversight reports and the payment-infrastructure statistics series. It is the navigational spine linking to most of the other authoritative lists in this cell, and its oversight reports (Report_oversight_YYYY.pdf) name individual systems and operators.

source_name: НБУ — Перелік важливих об'єктів платіжної інфраструктури в Україні
why_relevant: The NBU periodically designates and publishes a list of 'important payment infrastructure objects' based on payment-system oversight monitoring. This is a regulator-curated shortlist of the systemically significant systems and operators — effectively a ranked, named tier-1 target list, far more selective than the full register, and updated by news release so the changes are datable.

source_name: НБУ / Data.gov.ua — Державний реєстр фінансових установ (ДРФУ)
why_relevant: The State Register of Financial Institutions — the statutory census of licensed NON-BANK financial institutions (фінансові компанії, кредитні спілки, ломбарди, страховики, установи переказу коштів). Maintenance passed from Нацкомфінпослуг to the NBU in 2020. Because payment institutions and money-transfer companies historically sit here, it is the second half of the actor population that the bank register alone does not cover.

source_name: Фонд гарантування вкладів фізичних осіб (ФГВФО) — перелік банків-учасників Фонду
why_relevant: An independent second authoritative census of operating Ukrainian banks: membership in the Deposit Guarantee Fund is compulsory for every bank, so the participant list is a complete cross-check on the NBU bank list. The Fund also maintains an ARCHIVE of the participant list, which is the cleanest way to reconstruct historical bank populations and to date exits/failures — important when tracking which institutions a vendor's installed base sits in.

source_name: Єдиний державний реєстр юридичних осіб, ФОП та громадських формувань (ЄДР, Мін'юст) — через відкриті дані та API
why_relevant: The Unified State Register is the entity-resolution backbone: it supplies EDRPOU codes, legal names, KVED activity codes, beneficial owners and registered addresses. Every other register in this cell keys on EDRPOU, so the ЄДР is what lets vendor/competitor lists from the NBU, PROSTIR, Prozorro and Diia.City be deduplicated and joined into one actor map. KVED filtering (e.g. 62.01, 62.09, 66.19, 46.51, 95.11) is also a discovery channel for payment-technology vendors that appear in no sector register at all.

source_name: Держстат — Єдиний державний реєстр підприємств та організацій України (ЄДРПОУ)
why_relevant: The statistical register behind the EDRPOU identifier system, maintained by Держстат. Useful as the canonical explanation and, where published, as a source of the identifier-to-entity mapping and KVED classification used across all Ukrainian registers. Secondary to the Мін'юст ЄДР for live company facts but valuable for classification consistency.

source_name: Opendatabot — агрегатор державних реєстрів України (ЄДР, ліцензії фінустанов, судові справи)
why_relevant: Commercial aggregator that normalises and API-exposes registers this cell depends on — the ЄДР, the Державний реєстр фінансових установ / financial licences, court cases, and change notifications. Its practical value is operational: it survives the WAF and pagination problems that block direct scraping of bank.gov.ua and data.gov.ua, and it offers change-monitoring webhooks so new licences and de-registrations surface without polling. It is a derived source, so the state register remains the citation of record.

source_name: YouControl — аналітична система на базі 220+ відкритих реєстрів (вкл. резидентів Дія.Сіті)
why_relevant: The other major Ukrainian register-aggregation platform. Beyond ЄДР access it maintains derived markers and filters — notably a Дія.Сіті resident filter and sector/KVED segmentation — which is a practical way to enumerate Ukrainian IT and fintech vendors that could be competitors, integrators or partners in the banking-technology supply chain. Also publishes data-research articles that snowball into named company populations.

source_name: Реєстр резидентів Дія.Сіті (Мінцифра) — та похідні переліки компаній
why_relevant: State register of Diia.City residents — the special legal/tax regime for IT companies. It is the only official name-list of Ukrainian technology firms at scale, and it is where local banking-software houses, integrators and fintech product companies register. For a vendor/competitor cell this converts an otherwise unbounded 'IT vendor' population into an enumerable register. DOU maintains a well-known derived article mapping the registered legal entities (ТОВ/ПАТ/ПП) to their trading brands, which solves the register's main weakness — legal names that do not match market brands.

source_name: Prozorro — система публічних закупівель (закупівлі державних банків та держустанов)
why_relevant: Not a licence register, but a register-grade pointer to the SUPPLY side: state-owned banks (Ощадбанк, Укрексімбанк, Укргазбанк) and public bodies procure ATMs, POS terminals, cash-handling equipment, card personalisation and banking software through Prozorro, and every award names the winning supplier with its EDRPOU and contract value. This is the closest thing UA offers to a public vendor-and-contract register for banking technology. Caveat found in this run: PrivatBank, although state-owned, is not classed as a покупець under the law and only REPORTS its purchases to Prozorro, so its coverage differs.

source_name: Regulation.gov.ua — каталог державних функцій та дозволів (ведення реєстру платіжних систем)
why_relevant: The state deregulation catalogue documents, function by function, which body maintains which register and under which legal act — here explicitly 'веде реєстр платіжних систем, систем розрахунків, учасників цих систем та операторів послуг платіжної інфраструктури'. It is a meta-source for verifying WHICH register is legally authoritative for a given actor class and for detecting when a register is merged, renamed or abolished — a recurring problem in UA (e.g. the 2020 split, the 2024 transfer of the ДРФУ functions).

source_name: НБУ — нормативні акти щодо реєстрації ПРОСТІР та проєкти постанов (admin_uploads/law)
why_relevant: NBU regulations and draft resolutions published as PDFs under bank.gov.ua/admin_uploads/. These define the registration rules, the participant categories and the technical/certification obligations that determine which vendors can serve the market. Critically for collection engineering, the /admin_uploads/ file paths appear to bypass the WAF that returns 403 on the HTML pages, making them the practical route into NBU primary material.

source_name: OpenProcurement / Prozorro public API (public.api.openprocurement.org)
why_relevant: Machine-readable feed of every Prozorro tender object, including buyer identifiers (EDRPOU), CPV classification, lot values, bids, awards and contracts. This is the only realistic way to systematically harvest all ATM/POS/card-processing procurements by the state-owned banks over multi-year windows and to build a vendor win/loss matrix.

source_name: Prozorro API documentation (ReadTheDocs, uk/en)
why_relevant: Defines the data model (tender, lot, bid, award, contract, complaint objects) needed to design a reliable extraction pipeline and to know which fields carry vendor identity, price and losing-bidder information.

source_name: BI Prozorro public analytics module (Qlik Sense)
source_subtype: BI dashboard over procurement open data
why_relevant: Free analytics layer over all Prozorro procurement since 2015, built by the DOZORRO team. Lets an analyst compute market size by CPV, rank suppliers by contract value, and profile a specific buyer (e.g. Oschadbank) or a specific supplier (a competitor of Printec) without building a pipeline first — ideal for scoping before deep extraction.

source_name: BI Pro Prozorro (professional analytics module)
why_relevant: Paid/extended version of the analytics module with deeper cuts than the public one — relevant if supplier-level win/loss and price-per-unit analysis for ATM/POS categories proves impossible in the free tool.

source_name: DOZORRO (Transparency International Ukraine) procurement monitoring platform
why_relevant: Civil-society watchdog over Prozorro: risk indicators, AMCU decision practice, tooling and analytical write-ups. Useful for finding contested or cancelled banking-IT tenders and for narrative context around who challenged whom — a signal of competitive pressure between vendors.

source_name: Oschadbank official procurement page (Закупівлі)
why_relevant: The buyer's own publication of procurement notices and rules — including procurements that may fall outside Prozorro thresholds or exemptions. Gives the bank's own category naming and supplier-qualification requirements for ATM/self-service and IT purchases.

source_name: PrivatBank tender portal (tender.privatbank.ua)
why_relevant: PrivatBank publishes its own list of procurements separately from Prozorro; the bank is the largest ATM and POS estate owner in Ukraine, so its supplier selection is the single most important vendor signal in the country.
